## Notes

Series from 1993; designed and coded by Kevin Ryan, produced by Jeff Tunnell (Jeff Tunnell Productions), published by Dynamix/Sierra; MS-DOS, 3DO, later Windows and Mac; Rube Goldberg puzzles with fixed objects and provided parts; deterministic engine simulating gravity and air pressure; freeform mode; Contraption Maker successor.
